blocks.content: Rounding gives a number that is close enough but much easier to use. Rounding to the nearest thousand smooths a number to the nearest 1,000.
To round to the nearest thousand, look at the hundreds digit: 5 or more rounds up, 4 or less rounds down.

steps: 4 is less than 5, so we round down.

blocks.explain: The hundreds digit is 7, which is 5 or more, so round up to 5,000.
blocks.rule: To round to the nearest thousand, look at the hundreds digit: 5 or more rounds up, 4 or less rounds down.

blocks.content: The hundreds digit is the only one you need to check — the tens and ones do not change the rounding.

blocks.question: Round 8,512 to the nearest thousand.
blocks.explain: The hundreds digit is 5, which is 5 or more, so round up to 9,000.
blocks.rule: Check the hundreds digit only: 5 or more rounds up to the next thousand, 4 or less rounds down.

blocks.content: Check the hundreds digit: 5 or more rounds up, 4 or less rounds down. That is all there is to it. Let's practise!
